change: Carpark approach gate: a car passing through a shared lot is gated at the start of the outside road lane before the entrance connector, the same point already used for arriving (outbound) cars, for ranking, stopping and holding the gate. Gate refusals name the owning car (visible to blocking-cycle recovery) and a shoving car may pass a gate.
regression: SimulationChecks 'Original carpark gate goes to the car nearest the entrance, not the car queued behind' (v20 t=972 reconstruction): fails on 2026-11-08.3 (through car stuck on 'Carpark entrance merge', queued car on 'Queue ahead' after 60 s), passes on .4. The ranking part alone already passes it; the cycle-recovery part is a safety net.
rejected_first_attempt: Ranking all requesters by distance to the entrance itself (rank only, gating unchanged) made arriving cars lose the gate more often; the queue backed into the hub junction and ParkingFlow seed 42 layout 2 failed with a body overlap at t=22.85. A second attempt ranking through cars at the approach start but still stopping them at the connector let a through car (car 18) drive up to the west entrance and trap departing gate owner car 7 ('Carpark lane clearance' on both, from t~980), starving yellow 34 (3 served, game-over 1075.35 s). Both were discarded.
